notice: 已完成 2026-08-26 全量扫描。本轮无可严格确认在上次扫描后新发布的条目；历史补录 6 条（升学 2、研究 3、求职 1），状态变化 1 条。官方页面仅给出 8 月 25 日日期而无精确上线时刻的研究，均保守标为历史补录。

items.title: 用于个体精准功能脑图谱的多任务电池方法
items.title_en: Multi-Task Batteries for Precision Functional Mapping
items.summary: 研究提出介于静息态连接与单一任务局部化之间的第三条路径：用多种任务的激活模式共同定位个体脑区和建立分区。作者比较多任务与单对比局部化，在相同 fMRI 数据量下，多任务估计跨个体更一致、能更好保留真实个体脑区大小差异，并用数据驱动方法选择任务；优化后的任务组优于随机任务组，交错呈现也比按 run 分拆任务更可靠。代码和任务库已开放。eLife 评价为 Important / Convincing。局限是它仍是未修订的 reviewed preprint v1，并依赖参与者完成多任务、预先选定任务电池和特定验证数据；跨临床人群、扫描平台和更广脑区的泛化仍需独立复现。
items.summary_en: The work proposes a third route between resting-state connectivity and single-task localisers: combine activation patterns from multiple tasks to localise individual regions and build parcellations. Compared with single-contrast localisation using the same amount of fMRI data, multi-task estimates were more consistent across participants and better preserved genuine individual differences in region size. The authors also present data-driven task selection; optimised batteries outperformed random batteries, and interspersing tasks across runs was more reliable than splitting tasks by run. Code and a task library are open. eLife rates the study Important / Convincing. It remains an unrevised reviewed-preprint v1, requires participants to perform many tasks and researchers to preselect a battery, and still needs independent generalisation across clinical populations, scanners and broader brain systems.
items.relevance: 对个体化 fMRI、功能分区、实验设计和可复现工具链都很直接，且证据评价较强；必须明确它尚不是 Version of Record。

items.title: 社会隔离通过杏仁核—内侧前额叶通路增强雄鼠饮酒
items.title_en: Social isolation recruits amygdala–medial prefrontal cortex projections to escalate alcohol drinking in male mice
items.organization: Nature Neuroscience · UNC School of Medicine and collaborators
items.summary: 研究检验社会隔离如何改变酒精动机及其神经回路。作者在雌雄小鼠中使用双瓶选择行为、全细胞电生理、细胞分辨率钙成像和投射特异光遗传学。隔离使雄鼠饮酒增加、雌鼠降低；BLA→mPFC 神经元兴奋性与摄入量相关，激活该通路可提高饮酒，隔离期间抑制则降低酒精而不改变饮水，支持回路层面的因果作用。局限是后续机制实验主要集中于雄鼠，行为模型不等同人类酒精使用障碍，社会层级与隔离效应也可能依赖饲养和任务条件。
items.summary_en: The study tests how social isolation changes alcohol motivation and its neural circuitry. In male and female mice, the authors combine two-bottle-choice behaviour, whole-cell electrophysiology, cellular-resolution calcium imaging and projection-specific optogenetics. Isolation increased alcohol intake in males but reduced it in females. Excitability of BLA-to-mPFC neurons tracked intake; activating the pathway increased drinking, whereas inhibiting it during isolation reduced alcohol bouts without changing water intake, supporting a circuit-level causal role. Later mechanistic experiments focused mainly on males, the mouse drinking task is not equivalent to human alcohol-use disorder, and effects may depend on housing and task conditions.
items.relevance: 将社会经验、动机、性别差异与投射特异因果操作连接起来，属于高质量情感／认知神经回路研究；对人类行为的外推边界明确。

items.title: 少突胶质细胞 NRF2 功能障碍与人类年龄相关认知下降
items.title_en: Oligodendrocyte dysfunction in human age-related cognitive decline
items.organization: Nature Medicine · University of Edinburgh and collaborators
items.location: 英国／加拿大／美国（国际合作）
items.summary: 研究追问为什么同龄人的认知下降速度不同。作者把 Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 中 866 人从 70 至 82 岁的纵向认知轨迹，与死后胼胝体病理、转录组和少突胶质细胞状态联系起来，并用老龄少突胶质细胞特异 NRF2 敲除小鼠进行功能建模。较严重下降与更小的有髓轴突、异常增厚髓鞘、更多但 NRF2 下调的少突胶质细胞相关；小鼠敲除部分复现病理并削弱随时间的认知改善。局限是关键人脑病理分析样本仅约 13–21 人、属于死后观察关联且集中于胼胝体；小鼠遗传模型也不能证明 NRF2 激活剂能改善一般人群认知。
items.summary_en: The study asks why age-related cognitive decline differs markedly between individuals. It links longitudinal cognitive trajectories from ages 70 to 82 in 866 members of the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 to post-mortem corpus-callosum pathology, transcriptomics and oligodendrocyte states, then models function with aged oligodendrocyte-specific NRF2-knockout mice. More severe decline was associated with smaller myelinated axons, abnormally thicker myelin, and more oligodendrocytes with reduced NRF2; knockout mice partly reproduced the pathology and showed blunted cognitive improvement over time. Key human neuropathology analyses involved only about 13–21 donors, remain post-mortem associations and focus on corpus callosum. The mouse model does not establish that NRF2 activators improve cognition in the general human population.
items.relevance: 把长程认知轨迹、人脑病理／转录组与细胞特异动物模型连起来，证据链强，直接关联衰老认知、胶质生物学和多组学；临床转化仍需谨慎。

items.title: 香港大学牙医学院全栈 Web 开发员／IT Technician
items.title_en: Full-Stack Web Developer — IT Technician
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Faculty of Dentistry
items.summary: 一年内临时岗位，可续约；负责响应式网站和 Web 应用的前后端开发、安全、调试及技术支持。偏好 Node.js、Express、JavaScript、PostgreSQL、Vue、Laravel、SQL／NoSQL 与 Git，并把 LLM 集成列为加分项。通常要求计算机、Web 开发、计算机工程或相关本科 2:1 及一年经验，但官网明确高水平应届毕业生也会被考虑。申请需提交英文 CV 与作品集，滚动审查至 9 月 25 日或招满。
items.summary_en: A temporary role of up to one year, renewable subject to performance and funding, covering responsive websites and full-stack web applications, security, debugging and technical support. Preferred technologies include Node.js, Express, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, Vue, Laravel, SQL/NoSQL and Git, with LLM integration as an advantage. The standard profile is a 2:1 bachelor's degree in computer science, web development, computer engineering or a related field plus one year of experience, but the official page explicitly states that high-calibre fresh graduates will also be considered. An English CV and portfolio are required; review is rolling until 25 September or until filled.
items.relevance: 这是官网明确保留应届生通道的应用开发入口，并包含 LLM 集成与数据库栈；但专业口径偏计算机相关，作品集和完整全栈能力是实质门槛，且包含面向客户／终端用户的技术支持。

items.title: 新加坡国立大学人工智能与创新硕士（2027）
items.title_en: NUS MSc in Artificial Intelligence & Innovation (2027 intake)
items.organization: National University of Singapore · SCALE and six NUS schools/faculties
items.summary: 2027 年 8 月入学，官网明确欢迎 STEM、商科、艺术与社会科学、法律等所有学术背景。40 学分课程包括 AI 概念与评估、机器学习基础、AI 治理、技术创新与创业，并可选深度学习、Python、R、大数据和 capstone。四年制学士学位优先；仅持三年制非荣誉学位者需至少一年工作经验。IELTS 6.0 或 TOEFL 85。申请期暂列 2026 年 11 月至 2027 年 1 月，具体日期仍待官网更新。总学费为 58,860 新元（含 9% GST）。
items.summary_en: For the August 2027 intake, the official page explicitly welcomes applicants from STEM, business and management, arts and social sciences, law, and other academic backgrounds. The 40-unit curriculum covers AI concepts and evaluation, machine-learning essentials, AI governance, technological innovation and entrepreneurship, with electives in deep learning, Python, R, big data and a capstone. A four-year bachelor's degree is preferred; holders of a three-year non-honours degree need at least one year of work experience. IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 85 is required where applicable. The application window is currently listed as November 2026 to January 2027, with exact dates still pending. Total tuition is SGD 58,860 including 9% GST.
items.relevance: 跨专业口径非常宽，适合 AI 应用、创新和转型方向；但核心定位明显偏应用、治理、产品与创新管理，不等同于扎实的计算机转专业或算法研究硕士，且学费较高。

items.title: 新加坡国立大学人工智能科学硕士（2027）
items.title_en: NUS MSc in AI for Science (2027 intake)
items.organization: National University of Singapore · Department of Physics
items.summary: 面向 2027 年 8 月入学的 AI × 科学交叉项目。课程覆盖机器学习、深度学习及其在物理、化学、生物、药学和流行病学等领域的应用。常规申请期为 2026 年 10 月 1 日至 2027 年 1 月 31 日，滚动评审；早申轮已结束。标准背景为科学、工程或应用数学四年制／荣誉学位，相关三年制或其他量化／非量化背景的强申请者可结合专业经历个案审理。IELTS 6.0 或 TOEFL 85（旧量表）／4.5（2026 年 1 月 21 日后新量表）。国际申请还需上传至少 48,000 新元的资金证明。
items.summary_en: An interdisciplinary AI-for-science programme for the August 2027 intake, covering machine learning and deep learning across physics, chemistry, biology, pharmacy and epidemiology. The regular application cycle runs from 1 October 2026 to 31 January 2027 with rolling evaluation; the early cycle has closed. The standard entry profile is a four-year or honours degree in science, engineering or applied mathematics, while strong applicants with relevant three-year degrees or other quantitative/non-quantitative degrees may be considered case by case depending on professional experience. IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 85 under the old scale / 4.5 under the post-21-January-2026 scale is required where applicable. International applicants must also upload evidence of at least SGD 48,000 in available funds.
items.relevance: 科学背景转向 AI 驱动研究的路径非常直接，并保留科研和后续博士训练取向；但对非量化背景只作个案审理，且资金证明和自费成本需要提前核算。

items.title: 用于 DIA-MS 猪脑蛋白质组定量的开放光谱库
items.title_en: A porcine spectral assay library to quantify brain proteome by DIA-MS
items.organization: Scientific Data · Institute of Animal Physiology and Genetics CAS and collaborators
items.summary: 研究针对猪脑蛋白质组缺乏深度参考库的问题，使用亨廷顿病转基因小型猪的脑组织和脑脊液，经多种提取与分级策略完成 116 次 DDA-MS 测量，建立覆盖 89,392 条肽段、8,321 个蛋白的光谱库，约占猪蛋白编码基因的 36%。在独立 DIA/SWATH-MS 分析中，结合库与直接 DIA 的混合流程相对无库分析，在皮层、尾状核及脑脊液等样本中增加约 19%–59% 的可定量肽段。原始数据、光谱库和分析结果已存入 PRIDE（PXD074603）。
items.summary_en: To address the lack of a deep reference resource for porcine brain proteomics, the study used brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid from a transgenic Huntington's-disease minipig model, combining multiple extraction and fractionation strategies across 116 DDA-MS runs. The resulting spectral library contains assays for 89,392 peptides and 8,321 proteins, covering about 36% of porcine protein-coding genes. In DIA/SWATH-MS validation, a hybrid library-plus-direct-DIA workflow increased quantifiable peptides by roughly 19–59% across cortex, caudate and CSF sample groups relative to direct DIA alone. Raw data, the library and analysis outputs are openly deposited in PRIDE as PXD074603.
items.relevance: 这是可直接用于神经退行性疾病、大动物模型、质谱和生物信息方法开发的开放资源，也适合作为 DIA 数据处理与可复现分析项目素材。限制是验证样本规模较小、集中于特定亨廷顿病小型猪模型和仪器流程；资源提高覆盖率不等于已经发现人类疾病生物标志物，也不能自动跨平台泛化。

items.title: 精准 fMRI 显示健康衰老中语言网络保持稳定、执行网络选择性下降
items.title_en: Preserved topography, lateralization, selectivity, and functional connectivity of the language network in older brains
items.organization: Nature Communications · MIT / Boston University and collaborators
items.summary: 研究检验健康衰老是否会让所有高级认知网络普遍去分化。作者用个体内功能定位的“精准 fMRI”比较 64 名较年长成人与 483 名年轻成人，并分别定位语言网络和支持注意、工作记忆与认知控制的多重需求（MD）网络，还利用静息态和故事聆听数据评估连接。结果显示，语言网络的空间拓扑、左侧化、选择性和网络内连接总体保持稳定；相反，年长组 MD 网络的激活更弱、范围更小、个体差异更大且网络内连接下降。这支持衰老效应具有网络选择性，而非全脑统一去分化。
items.summary_en: The study tested whether healthy aging produces uniform dedifferentiation across higher cognitive systems. Using individually localized precision fMRI, the authors compared 64 older adults with 483 younger adults, separately identifying the language network and the Multiple Demand network supporting attention, working memory and cognitive control; resting-state and story-listening data were also used for connectivity analyses. Language-network topography, left lateralization, selectivity and within-network connectivity were largely preserved, whereas the older group showed weaker, less extensive and more variable MD activation plus reduced within-network connectivity. The findings support network-specific rather than uniform effects of aging.
items.relevance: 与认知衰老、语言、执行控制、工作记忆及个体化神经影像高度相关，也展示了为什么个体内功能定位可减少群体平均造成的网络混淆。主要限制是横断面年龄比较不能证明个体随时间的变化；年长组平均年龄约 60 岁且合并两个队列，任务和健康样本结果也不能直接外推至临床神经退行性疾病。

items.title: 香港大学创新学院机器人与机电原型技术主任／高级技术主任
items.title_en: Technical Officer / Senior Technical Officer — Robotics and Mechatronic Prototyping
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · School of Innovation
items.summary: 两年固定期全职岗位，可续约并附最高约基本工资 10% 的合约酬金及退休计划供款。高级职级通常要求相关高级文凭／本科及至少三年经验，并在机器人、电子、C/Python 嵌入式编程、Fusion 360 等 3D 建模中至少两项具备扎实经验；官网明确经验较少者可按 Technical Officer 考虑，应届毕业生亦可申请。工作包括维护原型制作工坊、支持项目制教学与科研、操作 3D 打印机／激光切割机／基础电子设备、举办工作坊并指导学生完成机电原型。9 月 20 日截止，滚动审查、招满即止。
items.summary_en: A two-year full-time fixed-term appointment with possible renewal, contract-end gratuity and retirement-scheme contributions totaling up to about 10% of basic salary. The senior rank normally expects a relevant higher diploma or bachelor's degree, around three years of experience, and strong capability in at least two of robotics, electronics, embedded C/Python and 3D modelling such as Fusion 360. The official listing explicitly states that candidates with less experience may be appointed as Technical Officer and that fresh graduates may be considered. Duties include maintaining a prototyping workshop, supporting project-based teaching and research, operating 3D printers, laser cutters and electronics equipment, running workshops and helping students develop mechatronic prototypes. Rolling review continues until 20 September or until filled.
items.relevance: 适合作为科研工程、机器人和硬件原型方向的初级入口，且应届生通道由官网明确确认。它并非纯算法岗：动手机电经验、工坊设备维护、教学支持和中英文沟通都很重要；有成型项目作品集时更值得投递。

items.title: MALDI‑TOF 质谱结合机器学习识别细菌与病毒
items.title_en: Enhanced classification and identification of bacterial and viral microorganisms by integration of MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry with artificial intelligence
items.organization: Scientific Reports · CERTH · Tallinn University of Technology · Belgian Defence Laboratories
items.location: 欧洲・希腊／爱沙尼亚／比利时
items.summary: 研究以 255 条内部 MALDI‑TOF 质谱（7 种细菌、5 种病毒）比较 8 个机器学习与 2 个深度学习模型，完成细菌／病毒、革兰氏类型和 12 类微生物分类；随后用 Robert Koch Institute 的 285 条外部细菌质谱检验泛化。内部交叉验证出现多个接近或达到 100% 的结果，但外部七类细菌识别明显下降：Extra Trees 约 80%，1-D CNN 约 71%，SVC 约 54%，说明内部高分不能直接外推到新实验室数据。
items.summary_en: The study compared eight machine-learning and two deep-learning models on 255 internal MALDI-TOF spectra spanning seven bacterial species and five viral strains, then tested generalization on 285 external bacterial spectra from the Robert Koch Institute. Several internal cross-validation results approached or reached 100%, but external seven-class bacterial identification fell to roughly 80% for Extra Trees, 71% for a 1-D CNN and 54% for SVC, showing that internal scores do not transfer directly across datasets.
items.relevance: 与医疗科技、生物信息、光谱数据和 AI 模型验证直接相关，方法与局限都适合用作医疗 AI 项目案例。主要限制是内部样本小、外部验证只覆盖细菌任务且跨数据集性能下降明显；不能把内部“满分”解读为临床可部署，也未见前瞻性临床验证。

items.title: 香港大学急诊医学高级数据分析师／数据分析师（RA I/II，多名）
items.title_en: Senior Data Analyst / Data Analyst — Research Assistant I/II (Several Posts)
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Department of Emergency Medicine, School of Clinical Medicine
items.summary: 一年期全职临时合同，可按经费和表现续约。岗位支持医疗服务研究，负责数据管理与分析、研究团队管理、项目协调和研究报告。官网标准要求统计、生物统计或相关专业本科及以上、约 3 年经验，但明确写明经验较少者可按 Research Assistant I/II 考虑；重视定量背景、数据可视化、多层模型、纵向数据、时间序列和复杂抽样，R／STATA 大型流行病学数据经验优先，Python／SAS 为加分项。8 月 24 日发布，滚动审查至 9 月 30 日或招满即止。
items.summary_en: A one-year full-time temporary appointment, renewable subject to funding and performance, supporting health-services research through data management and analytics, project coordination, team support and research reporting. The standard profile asks for a bachelor's degree or above in statistics, biostatistics or a related field and about three years of experience, but the official listing explicitly says candidates with less experience may be considered at Research Assistant I/II level. Strong quantitative and visualization skills are required; multilevel and longitudinal methods, time-series and complex-survey analysis are relevant, large epidemiological datasets in R/STATA are highly preferred, and Python/SAS are advantageous. Advertised 24 August, with rolling review until 30 September or until filled.
items.relevance: 医疗数据、统计建模和 R／Python 方向高度匹配，且官方保留低经验 RA I/II 通道，是今天最值得关注的新机会。需要注意“经验较少可考虑”不等于零经验保证；应在简历中突出毕业论文、科研项目、纵向／临床数据和可复现分析，并尽早投递。

items.title: 新加坡国立大学精准健康与医学 × 人工智能理学硕士（2027）
items.title_en: MSc in Precision Health and Medicine × Artificial Intelligence (PHMxAI), 2027 Intake
items.organization: National University of Singapore · Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine
items.summary: 2027 年 8 月入学，申请现已开放并滚动审理；国际申请截止 2027 年 5 月 31 日，本地申请截止 6 月 30 日。课程把基因组学、蛋白组学、药物发现、人工智能与大数据用于精准健康，可选一年全日制无 capstone、两年全日制含 capstone，或最长两年的非全日制无 capstone；研究／行业 capstone 更适合希望积累生物信息、医疗数据与研究成果者。应届生可申请：接受医学学位，或量化科学、工程、计算机、商科及相关健康科学荣誉学士；其他资格和相关经历按个案审理。非英语授课院校通常需 TOEFL iBT 85 或 IELTS 6.0，成绩须在两年有效期内。官网列示总学费为 73,650 新元（含 GST，2027/28 仍可能调整），并有择优、名额有限的学费奖项自动审理。
items.summary_en: Applications are open for the August 2027 intake and are reviewed on a rolling basis. The international deadline is 31 May 2027 and the local deadline is 30 June 2027. The curriculum combines genomics, proteomics, drug discovery, artificial intelligence and big data for precision health. Study options include one-year full-time without a capstone, two-year full-time with a capstone, or part-time study of up to two years without a capstone; the capstone route is the stronger research/industry option for bioinformatics and medical-data experience. Fresh graduates are eligible with an MBBS or an honours bachelor's degree in quantitative sciences, engineering, computer science, business or related health sciences; other qualifications and relevant experience are considered case by case. Applicants from non-English-medium universities normally need TOEFL iBT 85 or IELTS 6.0 within two years. The official page lists total tuition of SGD 73,650 including GST, subject to change for 2027/28, and limited merit-based tuition awards are considered automatically with a complete application.
items.relevance: 名校跨学科项目，适合希望把生命／健康问题转向 AI、生物信息和医疗数据的人；应届生与多类本科背景入口清楚，capstone 路径比纯授课更利于研究履历。局限是方向偏精准医学和组学而非通用计算机，其他生命科学背景可能需个案审理，且学费很高；应先判断资金与课程方向，再决定是否投入。

items.section: 科研／医疗／生物信息岗位
items.title: OIST 神经计算单元软件策展员（Neuro-Workflow）
items.title_en: Software Curator — Neural Computation Unit (Neuro-Workflow)
items.organization: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology Graduate University (OIST) · Neural Computation Unit
items.summary: 全职两年固定期岗位（含六个月试用，可续约），也列有最长六个月的兼职选项。岗位为 Brain/MINDS 2.0 的 Neuro-Workflow 平台测试、调优和维护神经科学数据分析／建模节点与工作流，协调输入输出互操作性，编写文档与 AI agent 指令，并与贡献者和用户排错验证。计算机、神经科学、生物或相关专业本科及以上可申请；Python 与英语沟通／技术写作为必需，计算神经科学、Git/GitHub、AI 辅助编码和日语为加分项。OIST 官方工作语言为英语，日语不是硬门槛。全职年薪约 400万–650万日元，另有搬迁、住房、通勤和社会保险等福利。官网将职级按资历归为 Staff Scientist 或 Technician，未列博士或固定工作年限门槛，当前招满即止。
items.summary_en: A two-year full-time fixed-term appointment, including a six-month probationary period, with possible renewal; a part-time option of up to six months is also listed. The role supports the Brain/MINDS 2.0 Neuro-Workflow platform by testing, tuning and creating neuroscience data-analysis/modeling nodes and workflows, coordinating input/output interoperability, maintaining documentation and AI-agent instructions, and troubleshooting with contributors and users. A bachelor's degree or above in computer science, neuroscience, biology or a related field is accepted. Python plus English communication and technical writing are required; computational neuroscience, Git/GitHub, AI-assisted coding and Japanese are preferred. OIST's official working language is English, so Japanese is not mandatory. Full-time compensation is approximately JPY 4.0–6.5 million per year with relocation, housing, commuting and social-insurance benefits. Appointment rank may be Staff Scientist or Technician depending on qualifications; no PhD or fixed years-of-experience threshold is stated. Applications remain open until filled.
items.relevance: 神经科学、Python、AI agent 与科研软件工作流结合非常直接，且本科／Technician 通道、英语工作环境和搬迁支持明确，是当前日本方向最匹配的科研工程入口之一。需注意职责包含文档、贡献者／用户协作和故障排查，并非纯独立开发；滚动招满，适合尽早投递。

items.title_en: Software Developer / IT Technician — Department of Emergency Medicine
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Department of Emergency Medicine
items.summary: 两年固定期全职岗位，可续约；官方的 Assistant IT Manager／Software Developer 广告要求计算机、IT 或相关本科，主管级通常需三年经验，但明确表示优秀应届毕业生可按 IT Technician 职级考虑并提供在职培训。技术栈包括 React、TypeScript、HTML、CSS、JavaScript、PHP、Node.js、MySQL／Postgres／SQL Server／Oracle，以及 DevOps、CI/CD 和 Git；负责社区健康、教学与行政工作流的应用开发、维护和系统支持。9 月 30 日截止，滚动审查。
items.summary_en: A two-year fixed-term full-time role with possible renewal. The Assistant IT Manager / Software Developer advertisement normally asks for three years of experience at the higher rank, but explicitly states that highly motivated fresh graduates may be considered at IT Technician rank with on-the-job training. The stack includes React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Node.js, relational databases, DevOps, CI/CD and Git. Duties cover development, maintenance and support for community-health, teaching and administrative workflow applications. Review is rolling until 30 September or earlier if filled.
items.relevance: 应届生通道明确，且全栈、数据库、DevOps 与科研／医疗系统工程结合度高，是本轮技术匹配最强的岗位之一。需要注意中英文书面口语、团队协作和现场系统支持；申请材料应明确按 IT Technician 职级申请，避免被主管级三年经验要求误筛。

items.title: 香港大学急诊医学数据协调员（技术助理／技术主任职级，多个岗位）

items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Department of Emergency Medicine
items.summary: 一年期全职岗位，可续约。本科接受数据管理、统计、计算机、信息系统、公共卫生等方向；工作要求数据清洗、质量保证、技术文档、数据报告和多方工作流管理，R、SAS、Stata、Python 及可视化／报告工具为加分。还重视数据保护、基础统计与分析、向非技术人员解释结果，以及领导和指导能力。9 月 30 日截止，滚动审查、招满即止。
items.summary_en: A one-year full-time role with possible renewal. Bachelor's degrees in data management, statistics, computer science, information systems, public health or related fields are accepted. The work calls for data cleaning, quality assurance, technical documentation, reporting and workflow management across stakeholders; R, SAS, Stata, Python and visualization/reporting tools are advantageous. Data protection, foundational statistics/analytics, communication with non-technical audiences and leadership or mentoring are also emphasized. Review is rolling until 30 September or earlier if filled.
items.relevance: 专业和技术要求与医疗数据分析较匹配，没有固定年限门槛；但官网标题写 Technical Assistant、正文写 Technical Officer，职级存在不一致，且多方工作流、沟通和指导要求较强，申请前应确认具体职级与实际独立分析占比。

items.title: SAP 中国 iXp Web 应用质量工程实习生（西安）
items.title_en: SAP China iXp Intern — Quality Engineer for Web Application, Xi'an
items.summary: SAP HANA 工具团队的有限期全职实习，侧重 Web 软件质量、性能与可扩展性，使用 JavaScript 测试浏览器界面或编写 JavaScript／Java 服务端逻辑，并用 AI／LLM 提升编码和测试效率。要求计算机、软件／计算机工程或相关专业的毕业生或在校生，具备 JavaScript UI、数据库和至少一种桌面系统开发经验；Java、Node.js、CSS、HTML5、全栈及个人编程项目为加分项。日常英语沟通，预计出差 0–10%。
items.summary_en: A limited full-time internship on SAP's HANA tooling team, focused on web-software quality, performance and scalability. Work includes testing browser interfaces or server-side logic in JavaScript/Java and using AI/LLMs to improve coding and testing efficiency. The listing accepts graduates or current students in computer science, software/computer engineering or related disciplines, with JavaScript UI, database and desktop-platform development experience. Java, Node.js, CSS, HTML5, full-stack work and substantial personal programming projects are advantageous. Daily communication is in English.
items.relevance: 与测试工程、Web 工具、数据库和 AI 辅助开发结合直接，官方明确包含 recent graduates，且没有多年经验门槛。风险是页面同时把 Career Status 标为 Student，毕业时间与 iXp 资格仍应在投入前确认；专业口径偏计算机相关，地点为西安且未列截止日，开放期可能随时结束。

items.title: 双相障碍模型中轴突线粒体运动、能量缺口与突触不稳定
items.title_en: Enhanced Axonal Mitochondrial Motility and Neural Activity-Induced Energy Deficits Destabilize Synaptic Transmission in Models of Bipolar Disorder
items.location: 美国・NIH NINDS／细胞神经科学与精神疾病
items.summary: 研究比较双相障碍供体来源的 hiPSC 皮层神经元，发现轴突线粒体运动和进出转换增加、突触前末梢稳定驻留减少，导致局部 ATP 维持与钙缓冲受损，并增加突触传递变异而非改变平均强度。AKAP11 敲低在小鼠神经元中复现相关缺陷；SNPH 缺失小鼠出现躁狂样表型。锂盐在这些模型中恢复线粒体驻留、能量维持、突触稳定性及部分行为表型。
items.summary_en: In cortical neurons derived from bipolar-disorder donor hiPSCs, axonal mitochondria moved and entered or exited more frequently, reducing stable retention at presynaptic terminals. This impaired local ATP maintenance and calcium buffering and increased synaptic variability without changing mean strength. AKAP11 knockdown reproduced the deficits in mouse neurons, while SNPH-null mice showed manic-like phenotypes. Lithium rescued mitochondrial retention, energy maintenance, synaptic variability and model-specific behavioral phenotypes.
items.relevance: 为精神疾病、突触能量学、线粒体运输和患者来源细胞模型提供较完整的跨模型机制链。局限是 hiPSC 神经元和小鼠躁狂样行为不能完整代表人类双相障碍；锂盐的模型救援不等同临床机制或疗效证明，供体异质性与长期疾病状态也仍需更大样本验证。当前为已同行评审 early-access 版本。

items.title: 组合式神经符号表征实现高效主动探索
items.title_en: Compositional Neurosymbolic Representations Enable Efficient Active Exploration
items.location: 加拿大／瑞士／英国・滑铁卢大学等／神经启发计算与主动学习
items.summary: 研究用受神经计算启发的高维组合向量构建贝叶斯优化算法，把标准方法随观测数增长的时间 O(n³) 与内存 O(n²) 成本，转化为随固定嵌入维度变化的 O(d²)。在多类探索任务上，计算时间缩短约 60–200 倍且未损失准确率；部署至神经形态硬件后，每次采样能耗降低约 30–188 倍。
items.summary_en: The study builds a Bayesian-optimization algorithm from compositional high-dimensional vector representations inspired by neural computation. It replaces the observation-dependent O(n³) time and O(n²) memory costs of standard methods with O(d²) costs in a fixed embedding dimension. Across diverse exploration tasks it reduced compute time by roughly 60–200× without accuracy loss, while neuromorphic-hardware implementation reduced energy per sample by about 30–188×.
items.relevance: 与神经启发 AI、长期主动探索、贝叶斯优化和神经形态计算高度相关，也适合作为算法与硬件协同复现方向。主要限制是结果来自选定基准和硬件条件，固定维度在更复杂、非平稳现实环境中的表达上限仍需验证；神经启发表征也不等同于证明生物脑采用相同优化机制。当前为已同行评审的 early-access 版本，后续仍会文字编辑。

items.title: 自由运动人类枕叶皮层的视动不匹配 EEG 反应
items.title_en: Visuomotor Mismatch EEG Responses over Occipital Cortex of Freely Moving Human Subjects
items.location: 瑞士・FMI／巴塞尔大学・人类移动 EEG 与虚拟现实
items.summary: 研究让参与者在虚拟环境中主动行走，并把视觉流与自身运动短暂解耦，再用移动 EEG 测量枕叶反应；结果显示视动不匹配会诱发稳定反应，且主动运动条件明显不同于被动观看，说明自运动信息强烈调制视觉刺激的皮层处理。作者把它解释为人类预测误差信号，并公开了数据与代码。
items.summary_en: Participants walked actively through a virtual environment while visual flow was briefly decoupled from self-motion, with mobile EEG recorded over occipital cortex. Visuomotor mismatches elicited robust responses, and active movement produced effects distinct from passive viewing, showing that self-motion strongly modulates cortical responses to visual input. The authors interpret the signal as a human prediction-error response and provide open data and code.
items.relevance: 与预测加工、感知—行动耦合、移动 EEG、VR 实验和可复现分析高度相关。eLife 将重要性评为 Valuable、证据评为 Solid；主要限制是把反应专门解释为预测误差仍属初步推断，且移动／VR 范式中的运动与感觉差异可能带来残余混杂，尚需独立实验和更直接的因果操控。

items.title: 重度抑郁障碍中的成人海马神经发生失调
items.title_en: Dysregulated Adult Hippocampal Neurogenesis in Major Depressive Disorders
items.location: 美国・哥伦比亚大学／人类海马与精神疾病
items.summary: 研究用非用药重度抑郁障碍供体与对照者的死后人类海马组织，整合单核转录组与染色质可及性、空间转录组和区域蛋白组，分析近 50 万个细胞核。结果显示成人神经发生相关细胞程序在 MDD 中停滞，三突触海马回路同时出现突触连接、能量代谢、细胞运输、炎症与应激相关改变；部分失调基因还与抑郁遗传变异或表观遗传调控重叠。
items.summary_en: Using postmortem human hippocampi from nonmedicated donors with major depressive disorder and controls, the study integrated single-nucleus transcriptomic and chromatin-accessibility profiling, spatial transcriptomics and regional proteomics across nearly half a million nuclei. Adult-neurogenesis programmes appeared stalled in MDD, while the trisynaptic hippocampal circuit showed changes involving synaptic connectivity, energy metabolism, cellular transport, inflammation and stress. Some dysregulated genes also overlapped depression-associated genetic or epigenetic signals.
items.relevance: 直接连接成人海马神经发生、情景记忆／模式分离与抑郁的细胞分子机制，也展示了多组学与空间数据整合。局限是死后横断面研究不能证明因果，供体和对照数量有限，且多数 MDD 供体死于自杀，难以完全区分抑郁病理、死亡方式、病程及其他混杂；目前不能据此声称恢复神经发生已被证明可治疗抑郁。

items.title: Penn LEAD：青少年执行功能发展的纵向多模态脑影像开放数据
items.title_en: Penn LEAD: Longitudinal Multimodal Imaging Data for Executive-Function Development
items.location: 美国・宾夕法尼亚大学／青少年认知神经科学
items.summary: Penn LEAD 数据资源包含 132 名入组时 8–16 岁参与者的 225 次纵向成像，其中约 27.3% 为典型发育、20.5% 为 ADHD、52.3% 为精神病谱系。除多项执行功能与临床表型外，还同时提供结构 MRI、扩散 MRI、n-back 任务 fMRI、静息态 fMRI 和动脉自旋标记 MRI；原始数据、完整处理后的衍生数据及质量控制建议均在 OpenNeuro 公开。
items.summary_en: Penn LEAD provides 225 longitudinal imaging sessions from 132 participants aged 8–16 at enrolment: 27.3% typically developing, 20.5% with ADHD, and 52.3% on the psychosis spectrum. Alongside executive-function tasks and rich clinical phenotyping, it includes structural MRI, diffusion MRI, n-back task fMRI, resting-state fMRI and arterial-spin-labelling MRI. Raw data, fully processed derivatives and detailed quality-control recommendations are openly shared on OpenNeuro.
items.relevance: 对执行功能、工作记忆、发育认知神经科学、跨诊断精神病理与多模态影像建模非常适合，也可直接用于可复现的数据项目。限制是样本规模对高维机器学习仍偏小、诊断组比例不平衡，临床转诊样本可能带来选择偏倚；这是数据描述论文，不应把可用资源本身误写为已证明某一因果机制。

items.section: 科研／医疗／生物信息岗位
items.title: 香港大学急诊医学临床研究高级科研助理
items.title_en: Senior Research Assistant — Emergency Medicine Clinical Research
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Department of Emergency Medicine
items.summary: 一年期全职岗位，可按表现续约；8 月 20 日公告，滚动审查至 9 月 10 日或招满即止。本科及以上即可，官网没有写固定工作年限。工作聚焦急诊科临床研究；文献综述、病历数据提取、数据分析及 SPSS／R 能力均为优先项而非统一硬门槛，并明确欢迎计划继续攻读研究型研究生的人申请。
items.summary_en: A one-year full-time appointment, renewable subject to performance, advertised on 20 August and reviewed immediately until 10 September or until filled. A bachelor's degree or above is accepted and no fixed years of experience are stated. The role supports emergency-department clinical research; literature review, medical-chart data extraction, data analysis, and SPSS/R are preferred rather than universal hard requirements. Applicants planning research postgraduate study are explicitly welcome.
items.relevance: 临床研究、病历数据与统计分析结合直接，资格文本比多数 Senior RA 更开放；但职衔为高级科研助理，实际竞争可能重视既往临床数据与论文经验。适合作为医学数据／研究生准备入口，申请材料应突出数据清洗、统计分析和可复现报告，而不能仅凭“本科可申请”判断难度。

items.title: 南安普顿大学人工智能硕士
items.title_en: MSc Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: 一年制全日制 AI MSc，国际申请已于 2026 年 8 月 19 日英国时间中午 12 点截止；英国本地申请截止仍为 9 月 2 日。课程覆盖智能体、机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉、机器人、进化算法与研究项目。硬性门槛较窄：需计算机科学、计算机工程、软件工程、人工智能、计算数学或信息技术等相关本科，通常要求 2:1 且成绩 65% 以上；还需至少一门线性代数／高等数学、一门 C／C++／C#／Java 高级编程，以及一门 AI／高级算法／机器学习课程均达到良好 2:1 水平。中国学历仅接受学校指定 Tier A/B/C 院校；IELTS 6.5、单项 6.0。国际学费 £35,000，通常需 £2,000 押金。对需要学生签证的国际申请者，本轮已不再是有效机会。
items.summary_en: A one-year full-time MSc in Artificial Intelligence. The international deadline passed at 12:00 noon UK time on 19 August 2026; the UK-applicant deadline remains 2 September. The curriculum covers intelligent agents, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, robotics, evolutionary algorithms and a research project. Entry is narrow: an upper 2:1 at 65% or above in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, AI, maths with computing, IT or a listed related field, plus strong marks in advanced mathematics/linear algebra, advanced programming in C/C++/C#/Java, and AI/advanced algorithms/machine learning. Chinese applicants must have studied at a listed Tier A/B/C institution. IELTS is 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component. International tuition is £35,000 and a £2,000 deposit normally applies. It is no longer an actionable option for international applicants who require a student visa.
items.relevance: 课程技术含量高但不属于转换型项目，并且国际申请窗口已经关闭；保留为历史参照，不再列入当前行动项。

items.title: 圣安德鲁斯大学线上数据科学硕士
items.title_en: Online MSc Data Science
items.summary: 灵活线上、自定进度的三年制 MSc，可于 2026 年 9 月、10 月或之后入学；9 月入学课程申请截止 9 月 1 日。接受任意学科 2:1 本科学位，课程覆盖 Python、机器学习算法、端到端机器学习、数据可视化、复杂系统、优化和数据驱动系统，并以软件成果型论文项目收尾。2026 年 9／10 月学费按每 15 学分 £1,500 计，估算全程 £18,000。最高 £6,000 的 9 月入学奖学金已于 8 月 19 日截止；课程本身仍开放，10 月入学奖学金截止 9 月 23 日。
items.summary_en: A flexible, self-paced three-year online MSc with September, October and later starts. The September 2026 course-application deadline is 1 September. It accepts a 2:1 bachelor's degree in any subject and covers Python, machine-learning algorithms, end-to-end machine learning, data visualisation, complex systems, optimisation and data-driven systems, culminating in a software-artifact dissertation. For September/October 2026 entry, tuition is £1,500 per 15 credits, about £18,000 overall. The September scholarship of up to £6,000 closed on 19 August; the programme remains open, and the October-entry scholarship deadline is 23 September.
items.relevance: 跨专业入口清晰，线上形式降低地域与签证限制；课程结构强调机器学习工程与完整数据产品。9 月课程申请仍只剩 12 天，但对应奖学金已关闭；若资金重要，10 月入学及 9 月 23 日奖学金节点更现实。

items.title: 香港大学公共卫生数据科学家／数据协调员
items.title_en: Data Scientist / Data Coordinator
items.summary: 公共卫生实践部 Senior Technical Officer／Technical Officer 层级，7 月 21 日发布，10 月 21 日截止或招满即止。本科可申请，专业可为数据管理、统计、计算机、信息系统、公共卫生或相关方向；硕士仅为优势。工作覆盖数据全生命周期、采集流程、质量检查、数据字典与审计轨迹、数据库管理、仪表盘和跨研究／供应商协作。官网重视 SQL、Excel／Google Sheets、REDCap／ODK／SurveyCTO／Qualtrics，Power BI／Tableau 为加分项，R／SAS／Stata／Python 为可取技能。
items.summary_en: A Senior Technical Officer / Technical Officer role in public-health practice, advertised on 21 July and open until 21 October or until filled. A bachelor's degree in data management, statistics, computer science, information systems, public health or a related field is accepted; a master's is only an advantage. The work spans the data lifecycle, collection workflows, quality checks, data dictionaries and audit trails, database administration, dashboards, and collaboration with researchers and vendors. The official listing values SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, REDCap/ODK/SurveyCTO/Qualtrics, with Power BI/Tableau advantageous and R/SAS/Stata/Python desirable.
items.relevance: 医疗／公共卫生数据治理与分析结合直接，且没有写死工作年限，是比多数资深 Data Scientist 招聘更可达的入口。风险是官网要求已有数据清洗、质控、文档与工作流经验，并强调跨团队沟通、领导和指导能力，实际层级可能高于普通初级 RA；应在简历中用项目证据对应数据质量、数据库和可视化。

items.title: 方向词内言语识别的 EEG–BCI 开放数据集
items.title_en: EEG–BCI Dataset for Directional-Word and Inner-Speech Recognition
items.location: 俄罗斯／西班牙语样本・脑机接口与开放数据
items.summary: 数据集记录 22 名健康志愿者（12 名俄语母语者、10 名西班牙语母语者）显性与隐性发音六个空间方向词时的 38 导 EEG（500 Hz），部分参与者同步采集咬肌与喉区 EMG。作者提供频谱、相干性和 Random Forest／SVM／LDA 基线，最佳分类准确率为 78±4%，数据已通过 Zenodo 发布，面向内言语 BCI 算法开发与基准测试。
items.summary_en: The dataset contains 38-channel, 500-Hz EEG from 22 healthy volunteers—12 native Russian and 10 native Spanish speakers—during overt and covert articulation of six spatial-direction words. A subset also has masseter and laryngeal EMG. Spectral/coherence analyses and Random Forest, SVM and LDA baselines reach a best accuracy of 78±4%. The data are released via Zenodo for inner-speech BCI development and benchmarking.
items.relevance: 适合 EEG 预处理、跨语言分类、语音想象和 BCI 复现项目。限制是样本量小、两种语言组不均衡、EMG 只覆盖部分参与者，标准分类器结果不能证明在真实交流场景或运动障碍患者中具备泛化和实时可用性。

items.title: 从慢性自激发到工作记忆的最小神经元与忆阻器模型
items.title_en: A Minimal Model of Working Memory in Neural Systems and Neuromorphic Circuits
items.location: 法国／美国・计算神经科学与神经形态计算
items.summary: 研究把常见脉冲神经元模型中的慢性自抑制适应变量替换为由钙介导膜电流启发的慢性自激发。这个最小改动在单神经元与兴奋性脉冲网络中产生稳健持续放电和工作记忆动力学；作者进一步推导稳定的平均场神经质量模型，并在最小忆阻器电路中实验复现单神经元动力学。
items.summary_en: The study replaces the slow self-inhibitory adaptation variable in common phenomenological spiking-neuron models with slow self-excitation inspired by calcium-mediated membrane currents. This minimal change produces robust persistent spiking and working-memory dynamics in single neurons and excitatory spiking networks. The authors derive a stable mean-field neural-mass model and experimentally reproduce the single-neuron dynamics in a minimal memristor circuit.
items.relevance: 兼具工作记忆动力学、可扩展脑模拟与神经形态硬件价值。主要限制是核心证据来自现象学模型、网络模拟和工程电路；忆阻器验证说明物理可实现性，但不能证明生物神经元以同一慢自激发机制维持工作记忆，页面仍为 early-access 未编辑版本。

items.title: 人脑分钟尺度持续行为的单神经元情境编码
items.title_en: Single-Neuron Dynamics Supporting Minute-Timescale Persistent Behaviour in the Human Brain
items.location: 美国／加拿大・人类认知神经科学
items.summary: 研究在 25 名神经外科患者中记录海马、背侧前扣带和辅助运动前区共 970 个单神经元，比较显式提示与需要潜在推断的任务情境。显式情境在海马和内侧额叶都可解码并在任务边界快速切换；海马编码随时间快速去相关、难以跨时泛化，而内侧额叶形成更稳定的静态编码。当情境必须从环境统计中推断时，海马也转为静态编码。
items.summary_en: Recordings from 970 single neurons in the hippocampus, dorsal anterior cingulate and pre-supplementary motor area of 25 neurosurgical patients compared explicitly cued with latently inferred task context. Explicit context was decodable in both hippocampal and medial-frontal populations and switched rapidly at task boundaries. Hippocampal codes decorrelated quickly and generalized poorly across time, whereas medial-frontal codes remained comparatively static; when context had to be inferred, the hippocampus also used a static format.
items.relevance: 对工作记忆、抽象规则、情境切换和人类单元记录高度相关，并清楚区分动态与静态群体编码。限制包括临床患者样本、治疗决定的稀疏电极覆盖、跨会话伪群体分析，以及观察性解码无法建立海马或额叶编码对行为的因果必要性。

items.title: 小鼠脑与循环网络中的可复用认知模块
items.title_en: Reusable Modular Architecture for Flexible Cognitive Operations in Mouse Brain and Recurrent Networks
items.location: 美国・系统与计算神经科学
items.summary: 研究让小鼠完成带延迟报告的延迟样本匹配任务，并记录内侧前额叶与顶叶皮层群体活动。降维与聚类显示，刺激处理和记忆维持分别占据可复用的神经子空间，并在新刺激及不同记忆内容间重复调用；数据约束的循环神经网络中，选择性静默对应神经元簇会特异损害相应计算，支持模块化且可复用的组织方式。
items.summary_en: Mice performed a delayed match-to-sample task with delayed report while population activity was recorded in medial prefrontal and parietal cortex. Dimensionality reduction and clustering identified reusable subspaces specialized for stimulus processing and memory maintenance, redeployed for new inputs and different memories. In recurrent networks constrained by the neural data, selective silencing of corresponding clusters disrupted specific computations, supporting a modular, reusable organization.
items.relevance: 直接连接工作记忆、神经群体子空间、任务组合与 RNN 机制建模。局限是复杂任务训练成功的动物只占初训样本一部分，记录来自小鼠有限皮层区；模型消融与数据一致并不等于证明生物回路中存在同样的因果模块边界。

items.title: 抗对称多谱指标识别高阶神经跨频耦合
items.title_en: Antisymmetric Polyspectral Indices for Higher-Order Neural Interactions
items.location: 意大利／荷兰／德国・计算神经科学与脑信号方法
items.summary: 研究提出一族抗对称交叉多谱指标，用于识别多个时间序列之间的高阶、多频非线性依赖，并通过反对称结构降低体积传导和瞬时混合造成的零时滞伪耦合。作者推导一般理论，以三次非线性模拟验证四阶交叉三谱指标，再在一名受试者的 EEG 上作探索性传感器级示范。结果显示该方法能给出与常规指标不同、符合高阶耦合假设的空间模式。
items.summary_en: The study introduces a family of antisymmetric cross-polyspectral indices for higher-order, multi-frequency nonlinear dependencies among multiple time series, designed to suppress zero-lag artefacts from volume conduction and instantaneous mixing. General theory is derived, the fourth-order cross-trispectral case is validated in cubic-nonlinearity simulations, and an exploratory sensor-level demonstration is performed on one participant's EEG. The method yields patterns compatible with higher-order coupling and distinct from selected conventional measures.
items.relevance: 与 EEG、theta–gamma／跨频耦合、FieldTrip 式脑信号分析和方法复现直接相关，适合作为计算神经科学方法项目候选。主要限制是实证部分只有单人 EEG、停留在传感器层级且为概念验证；尚无群体复现、源定位、真实因果网络验证或临床有效性证据，当前页面也仍是 early-access 未编辑版本。

items.title: 小脑如何表征双语叙事信息
items.title_en: Decoding How the Cerebellum Represents Bilingual Language Information
items.location: 中国・认知神经科学／语言
items.summary: 研究用 fMRI 比较熟练汉英双语者在第一语言与第二语言中理解相同叙事时的小脑活动和皮层—小脑功能连接，并以神经特征对当前叙事内容的可解码信息量衡量表征。皮层—小脑连接可稳定解码叙事内容，第二语言的信息量更高；语言差异主要关联默认网络与小脑额顶网络的交互。
items.summary_en: Using fMRI, the study compared cerebellar activity and cortico-cerebellar connectivity while proficient Chinese–English bilinguals comprehended matched narratives in L1 and L2. Connectivity patterns decoded narrative content, with greater shared informativeness in L2; cross-language differences were linked to interactions involving the cortical default-mode and cerebellar frontoparietal networks.
items.relevance: 与双语、语言理解、小脑、默认网络和多变量 fMRI 解码高度相关。主要限制是功能连接与解码属于相关证据，不能证明小脑—皮层耦合对第二语言加工的因果作用；熟练汉英双语样本和固定叙事任务也限制外推，当前页面仍为未经文字编辑的 early-access 版本。

items.title: 心衰相关认知损害中的内皮—小胶质细胞信号轴
items.title_en: Endothelial–Microglia Crosstalk in Heart-Failure-Associated Synaptic Loss and Cognitive Impairment
items.location: 中国・神经免疫／认知老化
items.summary: 研究在 8 月龄雄性小鼠中结合横向主动脉缩窄与血浆转移，发现心衰循环因子 TGFβ2 促使脑血管内皮细胞衰老，并经 MEK/ERK–MYC 诱导 SPARC；SPARC 再激活小胶质细胞 TLR4，导致神经炎症和异常突触吞噬。删除内皮 Tgfbr2／Sparc、删除小胶质细胞 Tlr4 或药理抑制 TLR4 均保护突触并改善认知。
items.summary_en: In 8-month-old male mice, transverse aortic constriction plus plasma transfer linked circulating TGFβ2 to brain-endothelial senescence and MEK/ERK–MYC-dependent SPARC release. SPARC activated microglial TLR4, promoting neuroinflammation and abnormal synapse engulfment. Endothelial Tgfbr2/Sparc deletion, microglial Tlr4 deletion and pharmacological TLR4 inhibition each preserved synapses and cognition.
items.relevance: 提供从循环因子、脑血管内皮到小胶质细胞与突触损失的多层因果链，连接心脑轴、神经免疫和认知。局限是核心证据来自雄性小鼠压力超负荷与血浆转移模型，尚不能直接外推至人类心衰患者、女性或临床治疗；当前仍是 early-access 未编辑版本。

items.title: 狨猴小胶质细胞中的同胞嵌合现象
items.title_en: Sibling Chimerism Among Microglia in Marmosets
items.location: 美国・神经免疫／单细胞基因组学
items.summary: 研究利用狨猴天然同胞嵌合现象，以基因型和单细胞转录组区分自身与同胞来源细胞。嵌合主要限于造血来源细胞，脑内以小胶质细胞和巨噬细胞最突出，而且比例在个体与脑区之间显著变化；结果提示狨猴脑免疫细胞的遗传来源可不同于宿主神经细胞。
items.summary_en: The study exploited natural sibling chimerism in marmosets and used genotype-aware single-cell transcriptomics to distinguish host- from sibling-derived cells. Chimerism was restricted mainly to hematopoietic lineages, especially brain microglia and macrophages, with substantial variation across animals and regions.
items.relevance: 对使用狨猴研究脑发育、神经免疫、疾病与细胞类型差异具有重要方法学意义。eLife 将其评为“Fundamental / Compelling”。局限是现象与比例可能具有狨猴特异性，样本与脑区差异会影响估计；它不能直接证明嵌合小胶质细胞造成行为或疾病表型。

items.title: 南洋理工大学青少年心理健康神经影像科研助理
items.title_en: Research Assistant — Neuroimaging and Adolescent Mental Health
items.organization: Nanyang Technological University · Youth Affective Neuroscience Lab
items.summary: 青少年情感神经科学实验室的全职科研助理，本科层级可申请，接受神经科学、心理学、数据科学或相关背景。工作包括大型纵向神经影像数据清洗与管理、多队列整合、统计分析、论文与项目交付；Python、MATLAB 或 R，神经影像与高级统计建模为优先项，机器学习为加分项。官方动态页面仍显示可申请，但未列固定截止日、签证担保或精确发布日期。
items.summary_en: A full-time bachelor-level RA role in adolescent affective neuroscience. Duties include cleaning and managing large longitudinal neuroimaging datasets, multi-cohort integration, statistical analysis, publications and project deliverables. Python, MATLAB or R are preferred; neuroimaging, advanced statistical modelling and machine learning are advantageous. The official Workday listing remains open but does not state a fixed deadline, sponsorship policy or recoverable exact posting date.
items.relevance: 与神经影像、心理健康、纵向数据、统计建模和机器学习高度匹配，硬性多年经验未写明。申请时应以可复现的数据分析或影像项目证明能力；因官网未写签证担保、语言门槛和截止日，国际申请者需尽快向招聘方确认。

items.title: 南洋理工大学帕金森病基因与功能基因组科研助理
items.title_en: Research Assistant, Neuroscience — Parkinson’s Disease Genetics and Functional Genomics
items.organization: Nanyang Technological University · Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine
items.summary: 神经疾病遗传与基因组实验室的科研助理，研究帕金森病相关基因的功能表征。接受生化、生物技术、生物医学或生命科学本科／硕士；通常希望有至少一年研究环境经验，但官网明确写明具有相关实习经历的应届生也会考虑。工作包括细胞培养、基因编辑、RT-qPCR、Western blot、共聚焦、流式、质谱，以及转录组／脂质组样本制备。官方页面未列固定截止日、签证担保或精确发布日期。
items.summary_en: An RA role focused on functional characterisation of Parkinson’s disease-associated genes. Bachelor’s or master’s graduates in biochemistry, biotechnology, biomedical or life sciences may apply. One year of research experience is preferred, while recent graduates with relevant internships are explicitly considered. Work includes cell culture, gene editing, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, confocal microscopy, flow cytometry, mass spectrometry and transcriptomic/lipidomic sample preparation. No fixed deadline or sponsorship policy is stated.
items.relevance: 保留了神经退行性疾病与基因组方向，且对有相关实习经历的应届生开放；但它以湿实验为主，不是数据科学岗位。缺少细胞培养、分子生物学或成像经验者不宜仅凭泛 AI／编程背景申请；国际候选人需另行确认签证。
tags: 应届生有相关实习可申请

items.title: 香港大学计算与数据科学学院 AI 工程师（科研助理 II）
items.title_en: AI Engineer (at the rank of Research Assistant II) — School of Computing and Data Science
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · School of Computing and Data Science
items.summary: 一年期 AI 工程岗位，本科及以上可申请，未写明硬性工作年限。工作是为法律研究、教学与社区项目开发下一代 AI 应用，技术栈包括 TypeScript/JavaScript、Python/Flask、Vercel AI SDK、MCP、agent tool calls、PostgreSQL/Prisma，以及 Azure OpenAI 和部署运维；滚动审查至 9 月 15 日或招满即止。
items.summary_en: A one-year AI engineering role open to bachelor’s graduates or above, with no fixed years-of-experience threshold stated. The appointee will build an AI application for legal research, teaching and community engagement using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python/Flask, Vercel AI SDK, MCP, agent tool calls, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Azure OpenAI and deployment tooling. Review is rolling until 15 September or until filled.
items.relevance: 它是 AI 应用与科研工程结合直接的本科层级入口，但官网同时要求已证明的全栈开发经历及较完整的生产技术栈，因此不是零基础岗位。适合已有可演示 Web/AI 项目者尽快投递；缺少 PostgreSQL、云部署或 agent/MCP 项目时竞争风险较高。

items.title: 单一计算目标也能产生视觉皮层流的功能分化
items.title_en: A Single Computational Objective Can Produce Specialization of Streams in Visual Cortex
items.location: 国际・计算神经科学／视觉系统
items.summary: 研究比较多类神经网络模型与 Natural Scenes Dataset 的大规模人类 fMRI 反应。加入局部拓扑约束、以自监督目标训练的 TDANN，比为不同视觉行为分别训练的模型更好地解释脑反应、视觉流的空间分隔与功能分化；结果表明，背侧、外侧和腹侧流未必需要不同任务目标才能涌现。
items.summary_en: The study compared neural-network models against the large Natural Scenes Dataset fMRI resource. A self-supervised topographic DANN with local spatial constraints better captured cortical responses, spatial segregation and functional differentiation across dorsal, lateral and ventral streams than models trained on separate stream-specific behaviours.
items.relevance: 直接连接视觉皮层表征、拓扑深度网络、fMRI 与脑启发 AI，适合作为表征相似性或模型—脑对齐项目。主要局限是模型拟合与涌现结果不能证明发育或进化因果机制；对比依赖特定网络、训练数据和 NSD，当前还是未经文字编辑的 early-access 版本。

items.title: 基线 theta–gamma 耦合调节认知训练与 tDCS 的长期效果
items.title_en: Theta–Gamma Coupling Moderates Response to Cognitive Remediation Combined with tDCS in Older Adults at High Risk for Dementia
items.location: 加拿大・EEG／神经调控／认知老化
items.summary: PACt-MD 随机试验的二次分析纳入 260 名平均 71.9 岁、患轻度认知障碍或缓解期重度抑郁的参与者。研究用 64 导 EEG 的 N-back 任务测量前额叶 theta–gamma 相位振幅耦合，并以混合效应模型追踪最长 6 年认知变化。高基线耦合组接受认知训练加 tDCS 后，全局认知和言语记忆下降更慢；低耦合组未见同样长期优势。
items.summary_en: This secondary PACt-MD analysis included 260 adults (mean age 71.9) with MCI or remitted major depression. Prefrontal theta–gamma phase–amplitude coupling was measured during a 64-channel EEG N-back task, and mixed-effects models tracked cognition for up to six years. Higher baseline coupling moderated slower decline in global cognition and verbal memory after cognitive remediation plus tDCS.
items.relevance: 与 theta–gamma、EEG、工作记忆、认知储备和非侵入神经调控高度相关。局限包括二次分析、以中位数二分连续耦合指标、样本以高教育白人为主，以及调节关系并不等同该振荡是治疗反应的因果机制；结果不宜直接转化为个体治疗选择。

items.title: PINK1 缺失扰乱包裹胶质并导致多巴胺神经元突触丢失
items.title_en: Parkinson’s Disease-associated PINK1 Loss Disrupts Ensheathing Glia and Causes Dopaminergic Neuron Synapse Loss
items.location: 欧洲大陆・比利时／果蝇神经退行性疾病
items.summary: 研究在年轻 Pink1 功能缺失果蝇中结合全脑单细胞 RNA 测序、包裹胶质细胞特异转录组、免疫组化、电生理和高通量遗传筛选。包裹胶质是转录失调最显著的细胞类型；健康胶质对维持多巴胺突触完整性重要，Vps13 和 Vps35 介导的囊泡运输可作为遗传修饰通路。
items.summary_en: Using young Pink1 loss-of-function Drosophila, the study combined whole-brain single-cell RNA sequencing, ensheathing-glia-specific transcriptomics, immunohistochemistry, electrophysiology and high-throughput genetic screening. Ensheathing glia showed the strongest deregulation, supported dopaminergic synapse integrity, and implicated Vps13/Vps35-dependent vesicle trafficking as a modifier pathway.
items.relevance: 把帕金森病、神经—胶质互作、单细胞组学和功能筛选连接起来，eLife 评价为“有价值、证据扎实”。主要限制是果蝇模型与人类少突胶质细胞并不等同，跨脑区胶质功能的一致性部分依赖假设；结果不能直接证明人类疾病机制或临床干预有效。

items.title: 香港大学自杀研究与预防中心数据分析科研助理 I/II
items.title_en: Research Assistant I/II — Suicide Research, Service Utilisation and Community Early Warning
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Hong Kong Jockey Club Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention
items.summary: 研究难以接触老年群体的服务使用情况及社区预警系统。本科可申请，接受统计、数学、数据科学、社会科学或相关专业；工作包括调查及其他数据的收集、清洗、分析和解释，证据综述、论文和报告撰写。要求掌握 R、Stata、Python 或 SPSS 至少一种，熟悉可复现流程、纵向／行政／大型社会调查数据者优先。
items.summary_en: The role studies service utilisation among hard-to-reach older adults and community early-warning systems. Bachelor’s graduates in statistics, mathematics, data science, social science or related fields may apply. Duties include collecting, cleaning, analysing and interpreting survey and other data, evidence reviews, and manuscript/report preparation. Proficiency in R, Stata, Python or SPSS is required; reproducible workflows and longitudinal, administrative or large survey datasets are advantageous.
items.relevance: 这是精神健康、社会调查和数据分析结合较直接的本科层级岗位；一年相关经验为优先项而非绝对门槛，技术能力强者也可考虑。岗位同时要求中英文、面向非技术受众解释结果、内外部联络，并可能在数据收集期安排不规则工时或周末工作，申请前应评估职责结构。

items.title: 跨脑区 ripple 协同支持分布式工作记忆表征
items.title_en: Cross-region Neuron Co-firing Mediated by Ripple Oscillations Supports Distributed Working Memory Representations
items.location: 国际・人类颅内电生理
items.summary: 研究分析 35 名药物难治性癫痫患者、43 次 Sternberg 工作记忆任务的颅内微丝记录，覆盖双侧海马、杏仁核、腹内侧前额叶、前扣带和 pre-SMA，共分离 1,373 个单神经元。约 90 Hz ripple 在远至 220 mm 的脑区间共同出现时，跨区神经元共放电提升约 30% 以上；效应随记忆负荷增加，并在提取阶段重现编码时的刺激特异共放电模式。
items.summary_en: The study analysed intracranial microwire recordings from 35 patients across 43 Sternberg working-memory sessions, sampling bilateral hippocampus, amygdala, vmPFC, ACC and pre-SMA and isolating 1,373 units. Co-occurring ~90-Hz ripples enhanced cross-region co-firing over distances up to 220 mm, scaled with memory load, and reinstated stimulus-specific encoding patterns during retrieval.
items.relevance: 该研究直接连接海马、神经振荡、跨区同步、单神经元记录和记忆表征。主要局限是癫痫临床样本、电极位置由治疗需要决定且区域覆盖不均；只测试 1 对 3 项的 Sternberg 任务，co-ripple 与行为表现的关系仍主要是相关性，不能单独证明因果通信机制。

items.title: 对抗式多任务神经网络分离阿尔茨海默病风险与遗传韧性
items.title_en: An Adversarial Multi-task Neural Network to Disentangle Genetic Risk and Resilience in Alzheimer’s Disease
items.location: 国际・神经遗传学／机器学习
items.summary: 研究构建对抗式多任务神经网络，用高遗传风险但未患病者与同等风险患病者学习“韧性”信号，同时去除低风险群体中的模式。模型先在模拟数据中评估，再应用于既有阿尔茨海默病遗传数据，生成独立于多基因风险分数的韧性评分，并筛出 5 个韧性相关 SNP；模拟结果优于传统方法。
items.summary_en: An adversarial multi-task neural network distinguishes high-risk unaffected people from affected people at comparable risk while unlearning low-risk patterns. After simulation benchmarking, it was applied to existing Alzheimer’s datasets, yielding resilience scores independent of polygenic risk scores and prioritising five resilience-associated SNPs.
items.relevance: 该工作把深度学习、遗传统计和脑疾病韧性连接起来，可作为医疗／生信 AI 方法案例。主要局限是特征发现依赖模型、样本定义和受控访问数据，五个 SNP 尚不能等同于已验证的保护机制；缺少实验性因果验证，代码也仅在合理请求后提供。

items.title: 香港大学精神科临床数据与神经认知科研助理 I/II（多个岗位）
items.title_en: Full-time/Part-time Research Assistant I/II — Psychiatry, Clinical Data and Neurocognition
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Department of Psychiatry
items.summary: 精神科招聘多个全职或兼职 RA I/II，本科可申请且明确欢迎应届生。专业可为生物统计、统计、计算机、数据科学，也可为心理学、社会科学或相关领域；工作按项目分配，覆盖初步数据收集、管理与分析、行政支持，或更深入的数据分析。团队研究精神病、自闭症、电子健康记录与神经认知，R 编程为加分项。
items.summary_en: The Department of Psychiatry is recruiting several full- or part-time RA I/II posts and explicitly welcomes fresh graduates. Eligible backgrounds include biostatistics, statistics, computing, data science, psychology, social science or related fields. Duties vary by assignment, from preliminary data collection and management to sophisticated analysis, across psychosis, autism, electronic-health-record and neurocognitive studies; R is advantageous.
items.relevance: 这是临床数据、R、电子健康记录和神经认知交叉的高匹配入门岗位，并被官网描述为良好的研究生训练机会。英语和中文均为明确要求，但官网没有把粤语单列为硬门槛；不同分配可能包含行政或数据收集，投递时应突出统计、编程和研究经历，并询问具体项目的数据分析占比。

items.title: 人类胎脑类器官模型揭示 IL-17A 驱动的皮层发育扰动
items.title_en: Modeling Maternal Immune Activation in 3D Ex Vivo Human Fetal Brain Cerebroids Reveals IL-17A-driven Disruption of Cortical Development
items.summary: 研究以孕 11–14 周人类胎儿背外侧前额叶组织建立保留神经干细胞、神经元、小胶质细胞、血管和细胞外基质的 3D 离体 cerebroid。IL-17A 激活小胶质细胞及边界相关巨噬细胞的 TLR/TNF/NF-κB 通路，伴随提前皮层折叠、皮层增厚及神经发生加速；转录组、蛋白组和成像结果相互支持，NF-κB 抑制在该模型中逆转多项表型。
items.summary_en: Using gestational-week 11–14 human fetal dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, the study developed 3D ex vivo cerebroids retaining neural, immune, vascular and extracellular-matrix components. IL-17A activated TLR/TNF/NF-κB programs in microglia and border-associated macrophages, with premature folding, cortical thickening and accelerated neurogenesis; multi-omic and imaging evidence converged, and NF-κB inhibition reversed several phenotypes in the model.
items.relevance: 把人类发育神经科学、免疫信号、3D 组织模型与多组学连接起来，方法学价值高。主要局限是离体胎脑组织和较小供体数；直接加入 IL-17A 不能完整代表母体免疫激活，也不能据此推断儿童神经发育结局或临床治疗效果。

items.title: 皇家墨尔本理工大学人工智能硕士（2027 第一学期）
items.title_en: RMIT Master of Artificial Intelligence — Semester 1, 2027
items.deadline: 未公布；名额满可提前关闭
items.summary: 2027 第一学期申请已于 2026 年 8 月 3 日开放，2027 年 3 月 1 日开学，学制两年、墨尔本 City 校区。计算机、科学、工程或健康相关本科且 GPA 达 2.0/4.0 可直接申请；其他本科可凭编程与统计课程或相关经验走替代路径。课程前段补足 AI 基础，后段可选行业项目或研究／小论文方向；国际学费为每年 47,040 澳元。
items.summary_en: Applications for Semester 1, 2027 opened on 3 August 2026 for a 1 March 2027 start. The two-year Melbourne program accepts qualifying bachelor degrees in computing, science, engineering or health with a 2.0/4.0 GPA; alternative entry is available through programming/statistics study or relevant experience. It progresses from AI foundations to an industry project or research/minor-thesis pathway. The listed international fee is AU$47,040 per year.
items.relevance: 对科学或健康背景转向 AI 的路径较清晰，官网写明无先修科目和无额外选拔任务；研究／小论文选项有利于保留科研出口。成本较高，且申请可能在满位前提前关闭；应先核验具体本科专业归类、课程成绩映射和总预算。

items.title: 层级资源理性模型解释人类阅读行为
items.title_en: Hierarchical Resource Rationality Explains Human Reading Behaviour
items.summary: 研究把阅读建模为词、句子和篇章三个层级的部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）：智能体在感知、记忆、时间与眼动成本约束下优化理解。模型复现词长、词频、可预测性、跳读与回视等经典效应，并在新的限时英文阅读数据中解释先验知识、篇章连贯性和时间压力的影响；代码已开放。
items.summary_en: A hierarchical POMDP model treats reading as resource-rational control across word, sentence and text levels. It reproduces classic lexical and eye-movement effects and explains prior knowledge, coherence and time-pressure effects in a new English reading dataset; code is open.
items.relevance: 与计算认知、有限资源决策、语言理解和可复现建模高度相关，可作为认知模型复现或扩展方向。主要局限是行为与计算层面的统一解释，并非神经记录或脑机制的因果证据；模型假设、参数及跨语言泛化仍需进一步验证。

items.title: 儿童与青少年 SSVEP 脑机接口开放数据集
items.title_en: A Steady-State Visual Evoked Potential-Based Brain–Computer Interface Dataset in Children and Adolescents
items.summary: Data Descriptor 收录 47 名 5–18 岁参与者的 EEG：包括标准 SSVEP 实验，以及参与者自行选择刺激的四目标在线游戏。研究比较不同对比度与尺寸的 12 种刺激，并用个体化刺激选择平衡舒适度和信号强度；频谱峰和信噪比还与两个既有数据集进行了对照验证。
items.summary_en: This Data Descriptor releases EEG from 47 participants aged 5–18 in standard SSVEP experiments and a user-choice four-target online game. Twelve contrast/size conditions support personalized stimulus selection balancing comfort and signal strength, with spectral and SNR validation against two existing datasets.
items.relevance: 与 EEG、SSVEP、脑机接口、儿科人机交互和开放数据项目直接相关。局限是样本量与年龄范围有限，不能证明临床疗效；结果受特定任务、刺激与设备影响，当前官方版本仍为尚未完成文字编辑的 early-access 版本。

items.title: 强弱记忆在反事实学习中的再激活与更新
items.title_en: Weak and Strong Memories Are Equally Reactivated During Counterfactual Learning, but Only Weak Memories Are Modified
items.summary: 参与者先学习知名虚构人物对食物的情绪反应，通过重复次数形成强、弱记忆，随后接触冲突的意外反应。强记忆对更新更具抵抗力，并损害对新冲突信息的记忆；弱记忆在反事实学习中被再激活至与强记忆相近的水平，且再激活越强，越可能整合新信息。
items.summary_en: Participants learned fictional characters’ emotional responses to foods, with repetition creating strong versus weak memories, then encountered conflicting outcomes. Strong memories resisted updating and impaired memory for new conflict, whereas weak memories were reactivated to comparable levels and were more likely to incorporate new information when reactivation was stronger.
items.relevance: 与记忆再激活、巩固更新、社会学习和虚假／竞争信息整合相关。主要局限是再激活来自行为代理指标，使用虚构人物的受控任务且没有神经记录；当前为 early-access 版本。

items.title: 奖励价值与预测误差对人类时间知觉的强化和干扰
items.title_en: Expected Reward Value and Reward Prediction Errors Reinforce but Also Interfere with Human Time Perception
items.location: 国际・时间知觉／强化学习
items.summary: 人类参与者复现 1,000、3,000 与 5,000 毫秒时距，研究期望奖励和奖励预测误差（RPE）如何影响时间学习。奖励而非惩罚的 RPE 会强化既往表现误差，同时在 1,000 毫秒条件下干扰学习率；较长时距没有出现同样模式。
items.summary_en: In a human interval-reproduction task spanning 1,000, 3,000 and 5,000 ms, reward—but not punishment—prediction errors reinforced prior performance errors and interfered with learning rate for the shortest interval, with no equivalent pattern at longer durations.
items.relevance: 连接时间知觉、奖励学习与预测误差，适合作为行为计算建模线索。局限是受控行为范式没有直接测量多巴胺或纹状体机制，结论受特定时距和奖励条件限制；当前为 early-access 版本。

items.title: 香港大学教育学院老年吞咽管理科研助理 I/II

items.summary_en: Bachelor’s degree holders and fresh graduates are welcome; a higher diploma plus three years’ experience is another route. Duties cover clinical delivery for older-adult swallowing-management research, data collection, entry and analysis, treatment/training in residential care homes, events and project deliverables. English and Chinese are required; Cantonese is preferred. On re-check, the official job URL redirects to a job-not-found page and the requisition is absent from current listings, confirming closure.
items.relevance: 状态变化：官方职位已撤下，不再作为可投递机会。该岗位本身也偏临床服务、外勤和高沟通。

items.title: 圣安德鲁斯大学神经科学 MRes（2027 入学）

Options include data science for psychology and neuroscience, machine learning/data mining, cognitive neuroscience methods and behavioural neuroscience. A UK 2:1 in a science-related subject is normally required; applicants must name three potential supervisors.
items.relevance: 研究占比高、接受多类科学背景，并兼具神经科学与数据方法，是本轮最匹配的升学补录。官网已开放 2027 申请，但具体项目发布日期无法确认，因此严格标为历史补录而非今日新发布；申请前需先筛选导师并评估研究契合度、学费与资金。

items.title: 昆士兰科技大学人工智能硕士（2027 入学）

items.summary_en: A two-year master's at QUT's Gardens Point campus with February and July intakes and an active international application route. The two-year pathway explicitly accepts a recognised bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum QUT-equivalent GPA of 4.0/7.0; the 1.5-year pathway is the one that requires an IT degree or another degree plus three years of IT experience. Study begins with programming fundamentals, databases and systems design, then covers machine learning, generative AI and large language models, natural-language processing, AI ethics and governance, plus a substantial industry project or research experience. The degree is professionally accredited by the Australian Computer Society. QUT reports a top-13 Australian and top-200 global position for Data Science & AI in the 2026 QS subject ranking. Indicative 2027 international tuition is AU$46,800 per year; IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0. The official course page does not list a single application deadline or its publication date, so applicants should confirm timing for the intended intake early.
items.relevance: 对非计算机本科的跨专业转换非常友好：两年制入口不要求既有 IT 工作经验，且课程包含编程基础和作品集型行业／研究项目。主要权衡是学费较高、项目偏职业型而非神经科学，以及需要尽早确认具体开学季的国际申请和签证时间。

items.title: 导航回路中的 theta 扫掠会随当前目标自适应聚焦
items.title_en: Adaptive modulation of theta sweeps in the brain's navigation circuit
items.location: 挪威・大鼠内嗅—海马导航回路
items.summary: 研究使用大规模 Neuropixels 同时记录大鼠内嗅皮层、海马及相邻方向编码区，并结合追逐移动食物、狭窄死胡同倒退和 REM 睡眠等行为条件，检验 grid-cell theta sweeps 是否只是随头向机械摆动。默认状态下扫掠左右交替；出现相关目标后，扫掠变窄、加速，并可脱离头向而指向猎物或计划中的运动方向，甚至先于实际转头。结果支持 theta sweeps 作为在内部空间图上选择性采样相关位置的动态机制。主要限制是大鼠导航与捕食任务，研究把现象谨慎称为“attention-like”，尚未直接证明扫掠是注意或决策表现的因果必要条件，也不能直接外推至人类。
items.summary_en: Large-scale Neuropixels recordings sampled rat entorhinal cortex, hippocampus and adjacent direction-coding regions across moving-prey pursuit, backward escape from a narrow dead end and REM sleep. Default grid-cell theta sweeps alternated left and right, but narrowed, accelerated and decoupled from head direction when a relevant target or intended movement became salient, sometimes turning before overt head movement. The results support theta sweeps as a dynamic mechanism for selectively sampling relevant locations in an internal spatial map. Limitations are the rat navigation and predation paradigms, the deliberately cautious 'attention-like' interpretation, the lack of a causal necessity test for attention or decisions, and uncertain generalization to humans.
items.relevance: 与 grid cells、theta 节律、认知地图、主动感知和目标导向规划直接重合，是本轮最值得优先阅读的研究。

items.title: 用于解析迷幻药作用的 HTR2A 工程化小鼠工具组
items.title_en: A suite of engineered mice for interrogating psychedelic drug actions
items.location: 美国・分子与回路神经科学
items.summary: 这项 Technical Report 构建了 Htr2a-EGFP-CreERT2、含人源 A242S 位点的 Htr2a 小鼠及组成型 Htr2a-Cre 小鼠，用于定位 5-HT2A 受体和细胞、操控相关回路并区分物种受体差异。作者用迷幻药诱导的行为变化验证工具效用，并在脑片电生理中发现 DOI 可显著提高遗传标记锥体神经元的放电。主要贡献是可复用的遗传工具，而非证明某种迷幻药具有临床疗效；小鼠行为与脑片结果、有限的人源化位点也不能完整复现人类主观体验或疾病。
items.summary_en: This Technical Report generated Htr2a-EGFP-CreERT2, humanized Htr2a-A242S and constitutive Htr2a-Cre mouse lines to map 5-HT2A receptors and cells, manipulate relevant circuits and address species-specific receptor differences. Psychedelic-evoked behavioral changes validated the tools, while slice electrophysiology showed that DOI robustly increased firing in genetically identified pyramidal neurons. The principal contribution is a reusable genetic toolkit, not clinical efficacy evidence; mouse behavior, slice physiology and a limited humanized receptor feature cannot reproduce human subjective experience or disease.
items.relevance: 对迷幻剂、5-HT2A、回路操控和神经精神疾病机制研究很有方法学价值，也适合关注开放工具与可复现实验设计。

items.title: 小脑节律的机制、功能与转化机会
items.title_en: Cerebellar rhythms: mechanisms, functions and translational opportunities
items.location: 国际综述・小脑振荡与神经调控
items.summary: 这篇 Review Article 汇总动物实验、计算模型和非侵入刺激证据，提出“频率—功能—调控”框架：小脑 theta、beta、gamma 及更高频振荡源自下橄榄核、小脑皮层颗粒层／分子层和深部核团的不同微回路，并通过跨小脑—皮层同步参与预测、误差校正、学习与内部模型更新。文章进一步讨论以节律为靶点的诊断和精准神经调控。它是证据整合与机制框架，不是新实验或临床试验；不同物种、记录尺度和刺激研究之间的异质性限制了转化结论。
items.summary_en: This Review Article integrates animal studies, computational models and non-invasive stimulation evidence into a frequency-function-modulation framework. Cerebellar theta, beta, gamma and higher-frequency oscillations are linked to distinct microcircuits in the inferior olive, cerebellar cortical layers and deep nuclei, and to prediction, error correction, learning and internal-model updating through distributed cerebello-cortical coordination. It also discusses rhythm-informed diagnostics and precision neuromodulation. The paper is a synthesis and mechanistic framework, not a new experiment or clinical trial; heterogeneity across species, recording scales and stimulation studies constrains translational claims.
items.relevance: 把神经振荡、计算模型、学习机制与神经调控连接起来，补足以海马—皮层为主的既有观察范围。

items.title: LRRK2 通过肌动蛋白骨架动力学调节突触功能
items.title_en: LRRK2 regulates synaptic function through modulation of actin cytoskeletal dynamics
items.location: 意大利／英国／美国／德国・帕金森病细胞与小鼠模型
items.summary: eLife 于 8 月 6 日发布 Version of Record。研究把文献荟萃、多组学、生化、成像和电生理结合到 Lrrk2 小鼠、细胞系及人 iPSC 来源神经元中，发现 BDNF 可激活 LRRK2 并把其互作网络推向突触肌动蛋白重塑；LRRK2 缺失会损害 BDNF 信号、改变突触后致密区结构，并影响人源神经元成熟和自发突触活动。eLife 评价为“重要、证据扎实”。限制是多为敲除与体外模型，年轻小鼠的部分结构表型随年龄正常化，尚无患者纵向证据或治疗性验证。
items.summary_en: eLife published the Version of Record on 6 August. Literature meta-analysis, multi-omics, biochemistry, imaging and electrophysiology were integrated across Lrrk2 mouse models, cell lines and human iPSC-derived neurons. BDNF activated LRRK2 and shifted its interactome toward synaptic-actin remodeling; LRRK2 loss impaired BDNF signaling, altered postsynaptic-density architecture, and affected maturation and spontaneous synaptic activity in human neurons. eLife assessed the study as important with solid evidence. Limitations include knockout and in-vitro models, partial normalization of young-mouse structural phenotypes with age, and no longitudinal patient or therapeutic validation.
items.relevance: 为帕金森病早期突触异常提供多模型机制证据，并展示组学与电生理、成像整合的研究路径。

items.title: RMIT 大学数据科学硕士（2027 入学）
items.title_en: RMIT University Master of Data Science — 2027 Entry
items.organization: RMIT University · School of Computing Technologies
items.summary: 两年制、墨尔本校区授课，2027 第一学期申请已于 8 月 3 日开放；国际申请截止 2027 年 3 月 3 日，但学校建议需学生签证者至少提前 4–8 周。官网接受 computing、science、engineering、health 或 statistics 本科，GPA 至少 2.0/4.0 或同等；其他本科需已修编程和统计，或有至少三年相关工作经验。课程从 Python、编程基础、数据库、应用分析和数据整理进入，再覆盖机器学习、贝叶斯统计、云计算、深度学习及 industry/research project。2027 国际生学费为每年 AU$47,040；IELTS 6.5、单项不低于 6.0。项目获 ACS Professional 级认证，且官网称其 Data Science & AI 学科在 2026 QS 学科排名全球前 100。
items.summary_en: A two-year Melbourne-based master's whose Semester 1 2027 application opened on 3 August. The international deadline is 3 March 2027, although student-visa applicants are advised to apply and accept at least 4–8 weeks before commencement. RMIT accepts bachelor's degrees in computing, science, engineering, health or statistics with at least a 2.0/4.0 GPA or equivalent; other degrees require completed programming and statistics study or at least three years of relevant professional experience. The curriculum starts with Python, programming, databases, applied analytics and data wrangling, then offers machine learning, Bayesian statistics, cloud computing, deep learning and industry or research projects. Indicative 2027 international tuition is AU$47,040 per year; IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0. The degree has ACS Professional accreditation, and RMIT reports a top-100 global QS subject ranking for Data Science & AI in 2026.
items.relevance: 对 science／health 等非计算机本科较友好，基础课程和研究选项能形成技术桥接；但若原专业不被学校归入 science／health，需用已修编程和统计课程证明资格。成本较高，应结合奖学金、签证和就业回报判断。

items.title: 香港大学临床试验中心项目执行／研究助理 I/II（研究中心管理）
items.title_en: Project Executive, Site Management — Technical Officer / Research Assistant I/II
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Clinical Trials Centre
items.summary: HKU 临床试验中心的全职项目执行岗位，可按 Technical Officer／RA I／RA II 聘用，官网明确提供完整在职培训并欢迎应届毕业生。接受生物或生命科学本科；工作包括项目可行性评估、物流和排期协调、伦理申请、预算与财务管理、临床研究合同及内外部沟通。8 月 19 日开始审查，9 月 4 日截止或招满即止。英语和粤语书面及口语能力为明确要求，普通话为加分项。
items.summary_en: A full-time clinical-trial site-management role appointable at Technical Officer or RA I/II level. HKU explicitly provides comprehensive on-the-job training and welcomes fresh graduates with a bachelor's degree in biological or life sciences. Duties cover feasibility assessment, logistics and scheduling, ethics submissions, budgets and financial administration, clinical-study contracts, and communication with internal and external collaborators. Review starts on 19 August and continues until 4 September or until filled. Written and spoken English and Cantonese are required; Putonghua is advantageous.
items.relevance: 层级和专业背景可达，但核心是多项目协调、伦理／预算流程和高频内外部沟通，并要求粤语；对于偏好独立、结构化分析任务的人，这是一条低匹配的临床研究入口，而不是数据分析岗位。

items.title: 南洋理工大学神经科学与人工智能科研助理／研究助理

items.organization: Nanyang Technological University · Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine · Nair Lab
items.summary: Nair Lab 的全职 RA／Research Associate 岗位，研究情绪等状态的神经计算。RA 接受计算机、神经科学、计算生物、心理学、生命科学或交叉背景本科；工作包括高维脑数据分析、独立研究、用机器学习和计算机视觉（含 LLM／VLM）进行视频高通量分析、数据驱动动力系统建模，以及维护实验室软件仓库。明确要求 Python 和 MATLAB，PyTorch／TensorFlow、OpenCV、PyQt／Gradio及大规模神经数据经验为重要技能或加分项。官方 Workday 当前显示 Apply，但未列固定截止日或签证支持。
items.summary_en: A full-time RA/Research Associate position in the Nair Lab studying neural computations underlying states such as emotion. The RA level accepts bachelor's graduates from computer science, neuroscience, computational biology, psychology, life sciences or interdisciplinary backgrounds. Work includes high-dimensional brain-data analysis, an independent research project, machine-learning and computer-vision methods including LLMs/VLMs for high-throughput video analysis, data-driven dynamical-systems modelling, and maintenance of research software repositories. Python and MATLAB are explicit requirements; PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV, PyQt/Gradio and large-scale neural-data experience are valuable. The official Workday listing currently shows Apply but provides no fixed deadline or work-pass commitment.
items.relevance: 这是目前库中计算神经科学、AI、动力系统和科研软件工程结合最直接的本科层级岗位之一；实际竞争门槛在可展示的 Python／MATLAB、神经数据或机器学习项目，国际申请者还需确认新加坡工作准证。

items.title: 人脑刺激增强细胞集合并连接细胞类型特异基因网络
items.title_en: Stimulation modulates gene-linked cell assemblies in the human brain
items.location: 美国・人类神经外科组织研究
items.summary: 研究建立人脑离体神经调控平台，将神经外科切除的颞叶皮层、微电极阵列刺激与同步记录、单核基因组学结合。电刺激增强了神经元细胞集合，并将这一生理变化映射到细胞类型特异的基因调控网络；作者还在接受体内刺激的人类皮层中识别出共同的细胞类型特异表达特征。它把神经调控、电生理和单细胞组学直接连接起来。主要限制是组织来自临床患者和切除皮层，离体刺激不能完整复制活体网络环境，研究也没有直接证明认知改善或临床治疗效果。
items.summary_en: The study developed an ex vivo human neuromodulation platform combining resected temporal cortex from neurosurgical patients, microelectrode-array stimulation and recording, and single-nucleus genomics. Stimulation strengthened neuronal cell assemblies and linked the physiological effect to cell-type-specific gene-regulatory networks; related cell-type expression signatures were also identified in human cortex following in vivo stimulation. The work directly bridges neuromodulation, electrophysiology and single-cell genomics. Limitations include clinically resected tissue, incomplete preservation of the in vivo network environment, and no direct demonstration of cognitive improvement or therapeutic efficacy.
items.relevance: 对神经调控、电生理、细胞集合和转化神经科学高度相关，也展示了如何把生理活动与组学层面的机制连接起来。

items.title: 去甲肾上腺素与多巴胺荧光传感器串扰取决于局部神经支配密度
items.title_en: Norepinephrine and dopamine sensor crosstalk depends on local innervation density
items.summary: 这项 Brief Communication 检验常用 GPCR 荧光传感器在真实脑组织中的递质特异性。小鼠成像显示去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺会交叉激活对方的传感器，串扰程度随局部神经支配密度变化：纹状体两类传感器主要报告多巴胺，M1 皮层主要报告去甲肾上腺素，混合支配区域最难解释。研究提示仅凭体外亲和力不足以判断脑内特异性，需要沉默特定投射等对照。限制是只测试若干传感器、脑区和小鼠模型，不能自动推翻使用其他版本或充分对照的既有结论。
items.summary_en: This Brief Communication tested neurotransmitter specificity of commonly used GPCR-based fluorescent sensors in brain tissue. Mouse imaging showed that norepinephrine and dopamine cross-activate each other's sensors, with crosstalk governed by local innervation density: both sensor classes mainly reported dopamine in striatum and norepinephrine in M1 cortex, while mixed-innervation regions were hardest to interpret. In-vitro affinity alone is therefore insufficient, and controls such as projection-specific silencing are important. Limitations are the selected sensor variants, brain regions and mouse model; the result does not invalidate studies using other sensors or adequate controls.
items.relevance: 对使用荧光递质传感器研究学习、决策和神经调控具有直接方法学影响，尤其提醒解释跨脑区信号时必须验证递质来源。

items.title: 基于忆阻器的人工神经流形与小样本时序预测
items.title_en: Artificial neural manifolds
items.summary: 研究用 NbOx Mott 忆阻器构建具有钟形调谐曲线的人工神经元群体，通过 GPFA 将放电压缩为低维流形，并基于延迟嵌入建立时空信息方程；加入记忆因子后，提高了预测准确度和鲁棒性。系统展示了不完整图像感知及癫痫发作预测，强调用群体几何而非单神经元完成近乎少训练的计算。主要限制是这是神经形态电子系统和算法验证，不代表生物脑采用同一实现；癫痫预测及能效优势仍需更广数据、强基线和真实部署验证。
items.summary_en: The study used NbOx Mott memristors to construct artificial neurons with bell-shaped tuning curves, compressed population spiking into low-dimensional manifolds with GPFA, and derived a spatiotemporal-information equation through delay embedding. A memory factor improved predictive accuracy and robustness. Demonstrations included incomplete-image perception and seizure prediction, emphasizing population geometry rather than individual artificial neurons. Limitations are that this is a neuromorphic electronic and algorithmic implementation rather than evidence that biological brains use the same mechanism; seizure-prediction and efficiency claims need broader datasets, stronger baselines and real-world deployment tests.
items.relevance: 连接神经流形、低维动力学、忆阻器和脑启发 AI，也可作为理解神经群体几何如何转化为硬件计算的案例。

items.title: 年龄特异模板提升跨个体脑功能 Hyperalignment
items.title_en: Boosting hyperalignment performance with age-specific templates
items.location: 美国／英国・成人全生命周期 fMRI
items.summary: eLife 于 8 月 5 日发布该经评审预印本的新版本，尚非 Version of Record。研究使用 Cam-CAN 成人全生命周期数据（18–87 岁、完整功能扫描超过 600 人）建立青年和老年年龄特异 hyperalignment 模板，并用独立 Dallas Lifespan Brain Study（20–90 岁）验证。年龄匹配模板在 hyperaligned 连接的被试间相关、个体连接组预测及电影反应预测中均优于年龄不匹配模板。eLife 评价为“有价值、证据令人信服”。限制包括横断面年龄比较、年龄分组的人为边界，以及仍需检验疾病队列和更多扫描协议；目前必须按经评审预印本而非正式定稿引用。
items.summary_en: eLife released a new reviewed-preprint version on 5 August; it is not yet a Version of Record. The study built young- and older-adult hyperalignment templates using the Cam-CAN lifespan dataset (ages 18–87, with more than 600 complete functional-scan records) and validated them in the independent Dallas Lifespan Brain Study (ages 20–90). Age-congruent templates outperformed incongruent templates for intersubject similarity of hyperaligned connectivity, individualized-connectome prediction and movie-response prediction. eLife assessed the work as valuable with convincing evidence. Limitations include cross-sectional age comparisons, discrete age-bin choices, and the need for tests in clinical cohorts and additional scanning protocols; it should be cited as a reviewed preprint rather than a final Version of Record.
items.relevance: 与自然情境 fMRI、个体化脑图谱、连接组和跨年龄模型泛化高度相关，对避免把单一年龄模板机械套用到所有人群具有直接方法学价值。

items.title: 电影诱发脑活动与连接的遗传性
items.title_en: Heritability of movie-evoked brain activity and connectivity
items.summary: 研究利用 Human Connectome Project 的 7T 电影观看 fMRI 双生子样本，通过被试间相关、频段分析和 hyperalignment 分解自然情境脑反应的遗传相似性。样本包括 51 对同卵双生子、34 对异卵双生子及 690 对无亲缘关系配对。同卵双生子的 BOLD 时间过程相似度比无亲缘配对高 59%、比异卵双生子高 24%；遗传性在慢频段和联想皮层更突出。eLife 评价为“有价值、证据令人信服”。主要限制是仍需更大、独立家系样本及基因型方法互证；慢频联想皮层解释部分依赖反向推断，fMRI 双生子设计也不能直接揭示遗传因果机制。
items.summary_en: Using 7T movie-watching fMRI from the Human Connectome Project, the study combined intersubject correlation, frequency analyses and hyperalignment to quantify genetic similarity in naturalistic brain responses. The sample included 51 monozygotic twin dyads, 34 dizygotic twin dyads and 690 unrelated dyads. Monozygotic BOLD time courses were 59% more similar than unrelated pairs and 24% more similar than dizygotic pairs, with stronger heritability in slow-frequency activity and association cortex. eLife assessed the work as valuable with convincing evidence. Limitations include the need for larger independent family and genotype-based replication, partial reliance on reverse inference, and the inability of twin fMRI to establish direct genetic mechanisms.
items.relevance: 直接连接自然情境 fMRI、个体差异、脑网络对齐与遗传性分析，对神经影像和计算认知方法学习价值很高。

items.title: 腹侧枕颞皮层的并行类别选择性活动挑战视觉识别层级模型
items.title_en: Concurrent category-selective neural activity across VOTC supports a non-hierarchical view of human visual recognition
items.location: 国际多中心・人类颅内电生理
items.summary: 研究汇总 140 名临床受试者、超过 11,000 个颅内记录位点，以自然人脸图片和 30–160 Hz 高频宽带活动追踪腹侧枕颞皮层的类别选择性。选择性强度从后向前增加，但约 100–450 毫秒的反应起止在不同 VOTC 区域大体同步，支持视觉识别包含广泛并行处理，而非严格串行层级。eLife 评价为“重要、证据令人信服”。主要限制是受试者来自癫痫等临床人群、植入位置由治疗需要决定，且人脸范式不能代表所有物体识别；时间同步也不能排除所有层级计算。
items.summary_en: The study pooled intracranial recordings from 140 clinical participants and more than 11,000 sites, using natural face images and 30–160 Hz high-frequency broadband activity to map category selectivity across ventral occipitotemporal cortex. Selectivity increased from posterior to anterior regions, yet response onset and offset were broadly concurrent across VOTC during roughly 100–450 ms, supporting substantial parallel rather than strictly serial hierarchical processing. eLife assessed the study as important with convincing evidence. Limitations include a clinical epilepsy population, treatment-driven electrode coverage, uncertain generalization from faces to all object recognition, and the fact that temporal concurrence does not eliminate every form of hierarchical computation.
items.relevance: 大样本人类颅内电生理直接检验视觉计算架构，与认知神经科学、时序神经信号和模型比较高度相关。

items.title: XunZi AI 生物学家生成并验证疾病修饰靶点
items.title_en: XunZi, an AI biologist, reveals disease-modifying targets
items.summary: 研究构建结合逻辑推理与多模态融合的 AI 生物学家 XunZi，训练语料覆盖 2,440 万篇文献及 613.6 TB 多源数据，涉及 21,008 个基因和 5,850 种疾病，用于生成疾病修饰靶点假设。系统提出帕金森病中的 CHK2 和 IRAK4 等候选，并通过药理和遗传抑制 Chk2 在小鼠模型中缓解多巴胺能神经元损失和运动缺陷；研究也涉及非小细胞肺癌验证。主要限制是动物和实验模型不能证明临床疗效，广泛基准与“自主科学家”能力仍需独立、前瞻性复现，超大且复杂的数据管线也提高可复现门槛。
items.summary_en: The study presents XunZi, an AI biologist combining logical reasoning with multimodal fusion. It was trained on 24.4 million publications and 613.6 TB of multi-source data covering 21,008 genes and 5,850 diseases to generate disease-modifying target hypotheses. The system proposed candidates including CHK2 and IRAK4 for Parkinson's disease; pharmacological and genetic Chk2 inhibition reduced dopaminergic-neuron loss and motor deficits in mouse models, with additional validation in non-small-cell lung cancer. Limitations are that animal and experimental models do not establish clinical efficacy, broad benchmark and autonomous-science claims require independent prospective replication, and the large complex data pipeline raises reproducibility barriers.
items.relevance: 把大模型／多模态推理、生物信息、靶点发现和神经退行性疾病连接在一起，是 AI 应用与计算生物交叉方向的重要案例。

items.title: 用“组合性连续体”比较生物脑与人工网络的智能机制
items.title_en: The compositionality continuum as a principle for studying the neural basis of intelligence
items.summary: 这篇 Perspective 提出用“组合性连续体”统一研究生物脑与人工网络中的智能：一端强调任务专用构件的表达力，另一端强调这些构件能否被系统地重组。作者建议结合动物复杂任务的高密度神经记录与神经网络逆向工程，检验通用智能是否需要显式符号组合性，或能从规模化分布式学习中涌现。它是概念框架与研究路线，不是新的实验数据；主要限制是尚无直接因果检验，关键主张依赖未来跨系统实验。
items.summary_en: This Perspective proposes a compositionality continuum for comparing intelligence in biological brains and artificial networks, spanning the expressivity of computation-specific building blocks and the complexity of their systematic recombination. It recommends combining high-density neural recordings during complex animal tasks with reverse engineering of neural networks to test whether general intelligence requires explicit symbolic compositionality or can emerge from scaled distributed learning. This is a conceptual framework rather than a new empirical dataset; its main limitation is the absence of direct causal tests, leaving central claims for future cross-system experiments.
items.relevance: 与计算认知、脑启发 AI、表征组合性和神经网络可解释性高度相关，但应作为观点框架阅读，不能与实证论文等量表述。

items.title: 嵌套情境变化与情景记忆的时间压缩
items.title_en: Nested contextual change and the temporal compression of episodic memory
items.summary: 研究用虚拟现实任务检验事件层级如何改变“何时、何地、什么”的情景记忆。参与者依次进入虚拟房间，在墙面 3×3 网格上观看图片，并判断图片的新旧、时间线位置和空间位置；两种条件分别为 6 个房间×4 张图片和 3 个房间×8 张图片，总呈现时长保持一致。早期项目和事件被回忆得偏晚，后期项目和事件被回忆得偏早，显示项目与事件两个层级的时间压缩；4 项事件的压缩率高于 8 项事件。研究支持时间记忆依赖嵌套事件结构，而“什么／何地”与“何时”可表现出不同的重建规律。主要限制是受控 VR 任务的生态效度有限、结果依赖行为时间定位而非神经记录，且当前页面为正式发表前尚未完成文字编辑的 early-access 版本。
items.summary_en: A virtual-reality experiment tested how nested event structure shapes episodic memory for what, when and where. Participants navigated virtual rooms and encoded images on a 3×3 wall grid, then judged recognition, timeline position and spatial location. Conditions used either six four-item rooms or three eight-item rooms with equal total duration. Early items/events were remembered as later and late items/events as earlier, demonstrating compression at both item and event levels; four-item events showed stronger compression than eight-item events. Limitations include the controlled VR setting, reliance on behavioural temporal-placement judgments rather than neural measurements, and the publisher's early-access unedited version.
items.relevance: 与情景记忆、事件分段、时间表征和认知建模高度相关，也可作为行为实验与 VR 任务设计的参考。

items.title: 萨塞克斯大学认知与临床神经科学硕士（2027）

items.summary_en: A one-year full-time MSc starting in September 2027, with an international deadline of 1 August 2027. Training covers fMRI, EEG, statistics, experimental programming, R and specialist neuroimaging software. The official page explicitly allows applicants from outside psychology, provided the personal statement explains their cognitive-neuroscience interest and transferable skills. IELTS is 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0. 2027/28 fees and scholarships are not yet published.
items.relevance: 从已关闭的 2026 国际轮次切换为 2027 开放，是明确状态变化。对生命科学背景、神经数据分析经历和希望补强 fMRI／EEG／R 的申请者匹配度高；当前无需紧急提交，但应等待学费与奖学金信息后评估成本。

items.title: 利兹大学神经科学研究型硕士（MRes）
items.title_en: MRes Neuroscience
items.summary: 2026 年 9 月入学、全日制 12 个月，国际申请截止 7 月 31 日。课程以 120 学分研究项目为主体，配有高级数据分析，并覆盖 circuits, systems and computations 等方向。通常要求相关科学学科 2:1；生物/生物医学最直接，自然科学或工程背景若能证明相应生物知识也可考虑。IELTS 6.5（单项不低于 6.0）。完整申请还要求在 supporting statement 中明确神经科学知识、职业目标、时间安排和资金路径，并通常安排面试。
items.summary_en: A 12-month, research-intensive MRes starting in September 2026, with an international deadline of 31 July. The 120-credit research project is paired with advanced data analysis and options spanning circuits, systems and computations. A 2:1 in a relevant scientific discipline is normally required; natural-science or engineering graduates may be considered with adequate biological knowledge. IELTS 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0 is required. The supporting statement must evidence neuroscience knowledge, career goals, schedule and funding route, and applicants are normally interviewed.
items.relevance: 2026 国际申请截止日 7 月 31 日已过，现不再作为可行动机会；保留为历史条目，并可观察后续入学轮次。官方课程页仍显示通用 Apply 入口，但未公布截止延期。

items.title: 香港大学禅修／正念神经影像与大数据实验室科研助理 I/II
items.title_en: Research Assistant I/II — Contemplative Neuroimaging and Big Data
items.organization: The University of Hong Kong · Centre of Buddhist Studies
items.summary: 一年期全职岗位，可续约；研究禅修、正念、注意和情绪调节的神经机制。工作包括建立数据分析管线、统计／大数据分析、数据管理，以及 EEG、fNIRS、ECG、PPG 等多模态信号的采集、预处理和分析。要求心理学、神经科学、生物医学工程或相关本科及以上，Python、R 或 MATLAB 编程，以及神经影像／生理数据处理经验；资历或经验较低者可按 RA I/II 考虑。中英文（含粤语、普通话）为“优先”而非明确硬性要求。申请滚动审查，招满即止。
items.summary_en: A one-year, renewable full-time role studying neural correlates of meditation, mindfulness, attention and emotion regulation. Work spans analysis-pipeline development, statistics/big-data analysis, data management, and collection/preprocessing/analysis of EEG, fNIRS, ECG and PPG. A bachelor's degree in psychology, neuroscience, biomedical engineering or a related field, Python/R/MATLAB skills and hands-on multimodal-data experience are sought; candidates with lower qualifications or less experience may be appointed at RA I/II level. Chinese including Cantonese and Putonghua is preferred rather than stated as mandatory. Review is rolling until filled.
items.relevance: 与计算神经科学、神经影像、编程和注意／情绪研究高度贴合；真正门槛是已有多模态数据处理经历，语言要求比多数 HKU 教育学院岗位更柔性，值得优先核对。
